Add a segment to the draft (flat alias of `draft <type> add`).
See `draft <type> add --help` for per-type semantics.

AGENT QUICKSTART (driving this as an agent? start here):
  Browse commands:  lyra-cli <domain> --help

USAGE:
  lyra-cli <domain> <[subdomain] ...> <action> [--flags] [--options]


OPTIONS:
  -h,     --help              Print this help message and exit
          --ref TEXT          Unified draft reference
          --type TEXT REQUIRED 
                              Segment type:
                              video/audio/sound/text/flower/sticker/filter/effect/picture_adjust/smart_colors/text_template/subtitle_template
          --resource TEXT     Resource: local:///<abs_path> or vimo://<id>; bare filesystem
                              paths are rejected
          --track TEXT        Target track index. Unitless whole-number index.
          --start <duration>  Timeline start, e.g. 0s. Explicit unit required: us, ms, s, or
                              min; bare numbers and m are invalid.
          --duration <duration> 
                              Duration, e.g. 3s. Explicit unit required: us, ms, s, or min;
                              bare numbers and m are invalid.
          --width TEXT        Media width in px (video). Canonical unit: px; the px suffix is
                              preferred and bare px values remain accepted. Range after
                              normalization: [1,2147483647]. Whole-number value required.
          --height TEXT       Media height in px (video). Canonical unit: px; the px suffix is
                              preferred and bare px values remain accepted. Range after
                              normalization: [1,2147483647]. Whole-number value required.
          --is-photo TEXT     Treat resource as a still image (video, true/false)
          --render-index TEXT Render layer index (video). Unitless whole-number index.
          --source-from TEXT  Resource source_from (audio/sound)
          --content TEXT      Text / template slot content
          --text-type TEXT    Material text type: text/subtitle/lyrics (text)
          --wrap-width TEXT   Fixed text-box width with normalized scalar or percent; content
                              wraps on overflow (text). Use a bare scalar or percent; the ratio
                              suffix is invalid. Range after normalization: [0,1].
          --name TEXT         Text-effect name
          --category-id TEXT  Text-effect category id
          --intensity TEXT    Filter/smart-color intensity with normalized scalar or percent;
                              defaults: filter 60%, smart_colors 50%. Use a bare scalar or
                              percent; the ratio suffix is invalid. Range after normalization:
                              [0,1].
          --apply-type TEXT   Effect apply scope: 2 = global (whole track). Unitless
                              whole-number index.
          --brightness TEXT   Adjust brightness. Unitless scalar.
          --contrast TEXT     Adjust contrast. Unitless scalar.
          --saturation TEXT   Adjust saturation. Unitless scalar.
          --color-temperature TEXT 
                              Adjust color temperature. Unitless scalar.
          --highlight TEXT    Adjust highlight. Unitless scalar.
          --shadow TEXT       Adjust shadow. Unitless scalar.
          --sharpening TEXT   Adjust sharpening. Unitless scalar.
  -v,     --version           Show version information and exit.
          --jq TEXT           Pretty-print JSON output; with an optional selector like
                              .result.items[0].id, output the selected JSON value instead of
                              the full schema envelope.

EXAMPLES
  # Add a video segment (generic entry, same as `draft video add`)
  $ lyra-cli draft segment add --type video --resource local:///x/y.mp4
  # Add an audio segment with an explicit duration
  $ lyra-cli draft segment add --type audio --resource local:///x/y.mp3 --duration 5s
  # Add a text segment on track 1
  $ lyra-cli draft segment add --type text --content "Hello" --track 1
  # Add a sticker from a resource id
  $ lyra-cli draft segment add --type sticker --resource vimo://123
